title: Re-ground after Feature Foundation
description:
## Objective
Record what the foundation established before five parallel workers build on it.

## Implementation
1. Update `.devmeta/project-history.md` with what was built.
2. Update `.devmeta/increments/increment-01-zmf/iterations/iteration-01.1/status.md`.
3. Append gotchas to `.devmeta/projects/2026-08-13-deck-foundation/context-log.md`.
4. Run `tk list --parent glx` to confirm the feature is clear.

## Tests
Run: `cd slides && npm run build` and `cd slides && npm run slides`
